questions.q: Per the chapter's velocity-band decision table, what log backup cadence does a HIGH-velocity database get?
options: Every 30 minutes
Hourly
Every 5 minutes
Every 15 minutes
questions.explain: The scheduler maps HIGH velocity to a weekly full, differential every 2 hours, and log backups every 5 minutes.

questions.q: What is the first stage of the three-stage continuous backup validation pipeline, and when does it run?
options: Structural integrity check, run synchronously after every backup
Restore smoke test in an ephemeral container
Application-level consistency check with business assertions
Weekly spot-check of a randomly chosen backup set
questions.explain: Stage 1 is a synchronous structural integrity check right after backup completion; stages 2 and 3 (restore smoke test and app consistency) run asynchronously.

questions.q: A backup is eligible for deletion only when:
options: It is older than 30 days
It has been migrated to Glacier
It has failed validation once
It fails all four retention tests: time-based, count-based, RPO-coverage, and compliance anchor
questions.explain: The lifecycle manager evaluates every backup against all four retention dimensions; deletion requires failing all four, with compliance anchors exempt from normal expiry.

questions.q: Why does the chapter separate restore plan computation from plan execution?
options: So plans can be sold to auditors as reports
So the system retrieves a pre-validated restore recipe at restore time instead of computing a restore sequence under pressure
To keep the msdb backup tables small
Because differential backups restore more slowly
questions.explain: Plans are recomputed continuously as backups complete, so a restore trigger retrieves a pre-validated recipe rather than calculating the backup chain in the middle of an incident.

questions.q: If a backup's validation state is FAILED and the backup type is 'full', what does the chapter prescribe?
options: Trigger an emergency full backup immediately and page on-call
Wait for the next scheduled backup window
Retry validation three times, then delete the backup
Downgrade the backup's catalog entry to differential
questions.explain: A failed full triggers a fresh emergency full backup plus a page; a failed log backup triggers a log retry with PITR-range invalidation in the catalog.
